comment.body_excerpt: If your Gateway runs as a non-elevated Scheduled Task, this may be #162047: without admin or Developer Mode, plugin capture falls back fro ... re pegged, no readiness). Enabling Windows Developer Mode fixed it for us on 2026.9.9 (ready in ~93 s from the task). Details in #162047.
